name: internal_test_final_v1
purpose: Final, single evaluation of the frozen source detector (user decision 2026-11-08) on the causal internal SIL/HIL test. Closes the source line. No change to model, threshold, onset or policy after this run, whatever the result.
history_disclosure: The internal test was used once before (ens_internal_test_v1, 2026-11-06, window level only): M0 and ENS numbers are known (M0 normal FP 475, TP 16510; ENS 342, 16662). GBT-alone test probabilities were computed in that run (test_predictions.npz) and a GBT@0.5 summary is stored in evaluation.json; it was not reported or used for any choice.
Model choice (GBT), window threshold 0.3744 and event onset 0.95 were fixed on train-CV / train held-out only (source_operating_point_v1, gbt_event_operating_point_v1). Nothing was chosen on test.
artifacts/q2_gps_fault_modes.csv contains the fault-mode parameters of the 48 test GPS cases (injection metadata, not predictions).
No event-level evaluation has ever been run on the test.

test_population.window: causal_input_v1 test, 34802 supervised windows, 553 cases (as ens_internal_test_v1)
test_population.event: all 553 test cases replayed continuously (as gbt_event_operating_point_v1)

frozen_models.M0_baseline: artifacts/causal_pure_mstca_m0_v1_20261101/results/runs/balanced_source_normal/best.pt, sha256 ac8596cd2e762a4b50845b79e312b1588e68956839a0e9c3573f88a05b5fc6cb (deployment baseline; T0 has no full-train model, so the window threshold's T0 reference cannot be reproduced on test)

operating_points.GBT_event: OnlineDetectionPolicy onset 0.95, clear 0.40, k_on 3, k_off 3, min_event 0.5 s, merge 0.5 s, inference_every 1

inputs_and_steps: window level: reuse test_predictions.npz (sha256 45360dbf5e136dc30e881bf9989cb0307683fe1cd6ff19ce8cdfde886411e8f8); no new inference
event level: per-frame scoring of the 553 test cases with the two frozen models, using score_ens_frames.py logic restricted to split test; no fitting
parity gate before any metric: frame scores at test window ends vs test_predictions.npz, GBT max abs diff <= 1e-6, M0 <= 0.002; model sha256 must match; else stop
write artifacts/internal_test_final_v1/TEST_EVALUATED.lock; the script refuses to run a second time
definitions: false event, independent-normal exposure, detected, spans_onset, confirmation latency: identical to gbt_event_operating_point_v1. Excluded from hard constraints: hover GPS mode-4 cases (event) / hover GPS mode-4 windows after 30 s (window), as in the source protocols.

primary_criteria.F1: independent-normal false events per valid-exposure hour: GBT@0.95 < M0@0.60
primary_criteria.F2: fault cases detected (excluded cases removed): GBT@0.95 >= M0@0.60 minus 1% of scored fault cases; per-class deficit > 2 cases flagged, not failing
primary_criteria.verdict: CONFIRMED if F1 and F2 hold, else NOT_CONFIRMED. Reported as is; no re-run, no re-threshold, no model change.

secondary_preregistered.F3_window_recall: per-class window recall GBT@0.3744 >= M0 argmax - 1 pp for 6 classes (GPS without late-hover mode-4 windows); reported pass/fail, does not change the verdict
secondary_preregistered.F4_latency: per-class confirmation latency median and P90, GBT@0.95 vs M0@0.60; classes with median increase > 2 s flagged (added because the source study's pooled latency guard was dominated by motor cases)

descriptive: window normal FP: GBT@0.3744 vs M0 argmax (different operating-point families; also list the known ENS 342 for context)
association_group cluster bootstrap (2000, rng 20261106) CI for the false-events-per-hour ratio and the window FP ratio
SIL / HIL split; by flight directory; hover alarm occupancy; pre-fault false events; spans_onset per class
excluded set: detected split by confirmation before / after 30 s; window recall of late-hover mode-4 GPS
case level: independent-normal cases with any false event; fault cases detected
not_allowed: any onset or threshold sweep on test
any operating point other than the four listed
after_run: internal test permanently closed for this project. The source line ends here; next is the cross-domain phase.
outputs: artifacts/internal_test_final_v1/; report docs/research/2026-11-08/内部test最终评价结果_v1.md
